en-US.first-person.flight.title: Personal Flight Unit
en-US.first-person.flight.description: Lets you <gl>leave the floor</gl> while walking your factory in first person. Also the way out of anywhere you manage to wedge yourself.
en-US.first-person.flight.mechanic.title: Personal Flight
en-US.keybinding.first-person.toggle.descripti: Stand on your factory floor. Hold shift to arrive where the camera is looking instead of at the vortex.
en-US.keybinding.first-person.fly.description: Toggles flight, which needs the Personal Flight Unit research. Double-tapping jump does the same.
en-US.keybinding.first-person.free-cursor.desc: Hold to get the pointer back for the HUD, the side panels and the menus.
en-US.keybinding.first-person.travel.descripti: Steps through the waypoints you have placed. Clicking one, or the home icon, travels there too.
en-US.keybinding.first-person.board.descriptio: Rides the train under the crosshair. Jumping gets you off as well.
en-US.keybinding.first-person.jump.description: Also rises while flying, and gets you off a train.
en-US.first-person.travel.title: Waypoint Beacon
en-US.first-person.travel.description: Lets you <gl>travel to your own waypoints</gl> from first person - with the travel key, or by clicking one on the map.
en-US.first-person.travel.mechanic.title: Waypoint Travel
en-US.first-person.travel.mechanic.description: Unlocks <gl>fast travel</gl> between waypoints in first person view.
en-US.first-person.train-riding.title: Rail Pass
en-US.first-person.train-riding.description: Lets you <gl>ride your own trains</gl> in first person - across platforms, up lifts and over the jumps between them.
en-US.first-person.train-riding.mechanic.title: Train Riding
en-US.first-person.train-riding.mechanic.descr: Unlocks <gl>boarding trains</gl> in first person view.
